What is AI Receptionist, and how does it work?
AI Receptionist is a call answering solution that listens, transcribes, and responds to calls, escalating to a human when needed — the first AI-led phone answering service with 24/7 human support.
What types of calls can AI Receptionist handle?
AI Receptionist screens leads, books appointments, blocks spam, and escalates complex calls to a human receptionist, delivering 24/7 complete coverage.
Will callers know they are speaking to AI?
Yes. AI Receptionist uses a conversational voice, and businesses can customize greetings to introduce the service transparently and professionally.

We employ 500 Virtual Receptionists across North America who are rigorously trained to handle a wide range of call scenarios across industries and applications. They work from quiet home offices to give you the experience of an in-house staff person, with none of the "call center" vibe.
Can I customize when calls escalate to a human receptionist?
Yes. Escalation rules are built into your call handling playbook and tailored to match your business needs.
How smooth is the transition between AI and a human receptionist?
Transitions are seamless, AI Receptionist will always inform the caller before connecting them to a human agent, avoiding cold transfers and jarring experiences.
How is billing structured for AI Receptionist?
Smith.ai offers simple per-call pricing with no setup fees, no contracts, no spam charges, and a 30-day money-back guarantee for risk-free signup. Subscribe month-to-month and cancel anytime.
Is there an extra fee when a call escalates from AI to a human receptionist?
No. Human escalation is included with every AI Receptionist subscription. Smith.ai is the first AI-first answering service that provides 24/7 human support.
How does AI Receptionist save businesses money compared to hiring in-house staff?
AI Receptionist offers 24/7 call handling without hiring, training, or managing staff — reducing overhead while ensuring no missed calls.
How does Smith.ai ensure call quality with AI Receptionist?
Every call is recorded and transcribed, providing a clear, verifiable record for quality assurance, training, and business documentation.
Is caller data secure with AI Receptionist?
Yes. Smith.ai follows strict security protocols including encrypted storage for call recordings and transcripts.
Can AI Receptionist integrate with my CRM and other tools?
Yes. AI Receptionist natively integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Clio Grow, Clio Manage, plus 5,000+ apps either natively, or through Zapier and Make.
